description: CASSI in Cary's Bond Park Route is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cary. Shuttle route for the Connected Autonomous Shuttle Supporting Innovation (CASSI) in Cary's Bond Park pilot. The North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) partnered with Cary to bring the CASSI program to Bond Park. Please see Cary's article and NCDOT's CASSI webpage for additional information about the program. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Transport, Movements, Internet of Things. Its keywords are CASSI, beep. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
